columns.name: pin
columns.description: Parcel Identification Number (PIN). The last 4 digits identify the unit within the building

columns.name: pin10
columns.description: Parcel Identification Number (10-digit). Identifies the condominium building

columns.name: card_num
columns.description: Card number. Generally not applicable to condominiums

columns.name: tax_year
columns.description: Tax year

columns.name: class
columns.description: Property class

columns.name: township_code
columns.description: Township code

columns.name: proration_key_pin
columns.description: Tieback key PIN. Prorated properties (whose value is split across multiple PINs) have a "main" or key PIN

columns.name: pin_proration_rate
columns.description: Tieback proration rate. Prorated properties (whose value is split across multiple PINs) pay taxes on the proportion of value on their PIN. In other words, assessed value is multiplied by proration rate to determine taxable assessed value

columns.name: card_proration_rate
columns.description: Card proration rate. Prorated parcels (whose value is split across multiple cards) pay taxes on the proportion of value on their card. In other words, assessed value is multiplied by proration rate to determine taxable assessed value. Cards are divisions within parcels, such as one of multiple buildings on a single parcel.

columns.name: year_built
columns.description: Year built

columns.name: building_sqft
columns.description: Condominium building total square feet. Sourced from listings and other sources

columns.name: unit_sf
columns.description: Condominium unit square feet. Sourced from listings and other sources

columns.name: num_bedrooms
columns.description: Condominium unit bedrooms. Sourced from listings and other sources

columns.name: num_full_baths
columns.description: Full baths. Defined as having a bath or shower. If this value is missing, the default value is set to 1

columns.name: num_half_baths
columns.description: Half baths. Defined as bathrooms without a shower or bathtub

columns.name: building_non_units
columns.description: Total condominium building non-livable parcel count. Includes parking, storage areas, and common areas

columns.name: building_pins
columns.description: Total condominium building parcel count. Includes both livable and non-livable parcels

columns.name: land_sqft
columns.description: Land square feet. Same for all units in a building

columns.name: cdu
columns.description: Condition, Desirability, and Utility code. Not well maintained.

columns.name: pin_is_multiland
columns.description: Multiland PIN indicator. Generally not applicable to condominiums

columns.name: pin_num_landlines
columns.description: Number of landlines on PIN. Generally not applicable to condominiums

columns.name: bldg_is_mixed_use
columns.description: Condominium building contains non-residential units

columns.name: is_parking_space
columns.description: Parking/garage space or storage unit indicator

columns.name: is_common_area
columns.description: Building common area indicator

columns.name: row_id
columns.description: Unique row key for API
